Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: The _____ was Emperor of Eastern Wu from 229 to 252.
Sun Quan.fact: Sun Quan (; 182 – 21 May 252 AD), courtesy name Zhongmou (仲謀), posthumously called Emperor Da of Wu, was the founder of Eastern Wu, one of the Three Kingdoms of China. Unlike his rivals Cao Cao and Liu Bei, Sun Quan was much younger and governed his state mostly separate of politics and ideology.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He inherited control of the warlord regime established by his elder brother, _____, in 200 AD
Sun Quan.fact: He inherited control of the warlord regime set up by his elder brother, Sun Ce, in 200 AD.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He declared formal independence and ruled from _____ 222 to May 229 as the King of Wu and from May 229 to May 252 as the Emperor of Wu
Sun Quan.fact: He declared formal independence and ruled from November 222 to May 229 as the King of Wu and from May 229 to May 252 as the Emperor of Wu.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: His administration proved to be relatively stable in those early years as _____ and Sun Ce's most senior officers, such as Zhou Yu, Zhang Zhao, Zhang Hong, and Cheng Pu supported the succession
Sun Quan.fact: Sun Quan was born while his father Sun Jian served as the adjutant of Xiapi County. After Sun Jian's death in the early 190s, he and his family lived at various cities on the lower Yangtze, until Sun Ce carved out a warlord regime in the Jiangdong region, based on his own followers and a number of local clan allegiances.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In early 208 AD, his forces finally won complete victory over _____, a military leader under Liu Biao, who dominated the middle Yangtze
Sun Quan.fact: In early 208 AD, his forces finally won complete victory over Huang Zu, a military leader under Liu Biao, who dominated the middle Yangtze. Huang Zu was killed in battle.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In winter of that year, the northern warlord _____ led an army of approximately 220,000 to conquer the south to complete the reunification of China
Sun Quan.fact: In winter of that year, the northern warlord Cao Cao led an army of approximately 220,000 to conquer the south to complete the reunification of China. Eventually, Sun Quan decided to oppose Cao Cao in the middle Yangtze with his superior riverine forces.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: One, led by _____, urged surrender whilst the other, led by Zhou Yu and Lu Su, opposed capitulation
Sun Quan.fact: One, led by Zhang Zhao, urged surrender whilst the other, led by Zhou Yu and Lu Su, opposed capitulation.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In late 220 AD, _____, King of Wei, Cao Cao's son and successor, seized the throne and proclaimed himself to be the Emperor of China, ending and succeeding the nominal rule of the Han dynasty
Sun Quan.fact: In late 220 AD, Cao Pi, King of Wei, Cao Cao's son and successor, seized the throne and proclaimed himself to be the Emperor of China, ending and succeeding the nominal rule of the Han dynasty. At first, Sun Quan nominally served as a Wei vassal with the Wei-created title of King of Wu, but after, Cao Pi demanded that he send his son Sun Deng as a hostage to the Wei capital Luoyang and he refused.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: After the death of his original crown prince, _____, two opposing factions supporting different potential successors slowly emerged
Sun Quan.fact: At first, Sun Quan nominally served as a Wei vassal with the Wei-created title of King of Wu, but after, Cao Pi demanded that he send his son Sun Deng as a hostage to the Wei capital Luoyang and he refused. After the death of his original crown prince, Sun Deng, two opposing factions supporting different potential successors slowly emerged.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: When Sun He succeeded _____ as the new crown prince, he was supported by Lu Xun and Zhuge Ke, while his rival Sun Ba was supported by Quan Cong and Bu Zhi and their clans

After the death of his original crown prince, Sun Deng, two opposing factions supporting different potential successors slowly emerged.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He enjoyed the longest reign among all the founders of the Three Kingdoms and was succeeded by his son, _____
Sun Quan.fact: He enjoyed the longest reign among all the founders of the Three Kingdoms and was succeeded by his son, Sun Liang.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He was the second son of _____ and his wife Lady Wu; he had two younger full brothers, Sun Yi and Sun Kuang, and a younger full sister, whose identity is unrecorded
Sun Quan.fact: Sun Quan was born in 182, while his father Sun Jian was still a low-ranking official of the Han dynasty. He was the second son of Sun Jian and his wife Lady Wu; he had two younger full brothers, Sun Yi and Sun Kuang, and a younger full sister, whose identity is unrecorded.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Sun Jian joined the general _____ to quell the rebellion and allocated his family to stay in Shouchun
Sun Quan.fact: Sun Jian joined the general Zhu Jun to quell the rebellion and allocated his family to stay in Shouchun.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: There, the Sun family became acquainted with _____
Sun Quan.fact: When Sun Quan's elder brother Sun Ce met Zhou Yu in 189, Sun Ce decided to take his mother Lady Wu and younger brothers to Shu County, Zhou Yu's hometown. There, the Sun family became acquainted with Zhou Yu.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Two years later, _____ decided to join Yuan Shu's army so he ordered Lü Fan to take his family members to his maternal uncle Wu Jing's home in Danyang
Sun Quan.fact: When Sun Quan's elder brother Sun Ce met Zhou Yu in 189, Sun Ce decided to take his mother Lady Wu and younger brothers to Shu County, Zhou Yu's hometown. Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: However, _____, the Governor (牧) of Yang Province became angry when Sun Ce and Yuan Shu defeated Lu Kang, the administrator of Lujiang in 194
Sun Quan.fact: However, Liu Yao, the Governor (牧) of Yang Province became angry when Sun Ce and Yuan Shu defeated Lu Kang, the administrator of Lujiang in 194. Since Sun Quan and his mother were still in Liu Yao's territory, Zhu Zhi sent people to rescue them.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He felt worried that they would attack him further so he drove _____ away from Danyang
Sun Quan.fact: Two years later, Sun Ce decided to join Yuan Shu's army so he ordered Lü Fan to take his family members to his maternal uncle Wu Jing's home in Danyang. He felt worried that they would attack him further so he drove Wu Jing away from Danyang.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He was made _____ magistrate in 196, at the age of 14, and continued to rise through the ranks as his brother gave him more and more important tasks
Sun Quan.fact: He was made Yangxian County magistrate in 196, at the age of 14, and continued to rise through the ranks as his brother gave him more and more important tasks.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Since he was passionate about gathering the retainers like _____ and Zhou Tai, his fame soon approached his father and elder brother
Sun Quan.fact: Since he was passionate about gathering the retainers like Pan Zhang and Zhou Tai, his fame soon approached his father and elder brother.

Sun Quan.question: Zhu Ran and _____, the men he met during his schooldays, later became ministers of Eastern Wu
Sun Quan.fact: Zhu Ran and Hu Zong, the men he met during his schooldays, later became ministers of Eastern Wu.

Sun Quan.question: He made war on _____ twice in 203 and 207

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In 208, he was finally able to defeat and kill _____ in battle, and as a result, he obtained most of the territory of Jiangxia

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Liu Cong therefore succeeded _____ after his death, and Liu Qi was displeased and considered, but did not carry out, an attack against his brother

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Nevertheless, _____, in fear of having to fight Cao Cao and his brother on two fronts, surrendered to Cao Cao against the advice of Liu Biao's key ally Liu Bei
Sun Quan.fact: After Liu Biao's death, a succession struggle for his domain came into being, between his sons Liu Qi and younger son Liu Cong, whom Liu Biao's second wife Lady Cai favoured (because he had married her niece). Liu Cong therefore succeeded Liu Biao after his death, and Liu Qi was displeased and considered, but did not carry out, an attack against his brother.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Cao caught up to him and crushed his forces, but _____ escaped with his life; he fled to Dangyang
Sun Quan.fact: Nevertheless, Liu Cong, in fear of having to fight Cao Cao and his brother on two fronts, surrendered to Cao Cao against the advice of Liu Biao's key ally Liu Bei. Cao caught up to him and crushed his forces, but Liu Bei escaped with his life; he fled to Dangyang.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Cao Cao took over most of _____, and appeared set on finally unifying the empire
Sun Quan.fact: Cao Cao took over most of Jing Province, and appeared set on finally unifying the empire.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: About this time, there was a plague developing in _____'s forces which significantly weakened it
Sun Quan.fact: Cao Cao wrote Sun Quan with a letter intending to intimidate, and in face of Cao's overwhelming force (estimated to be about 220,000 men, although Cao claimed 800,000, against Sun's 30,000 and the Lius' combined force of 10,000), many of Sun's subordinates, including Zhang Zhao, advocated surrender. Sun Quan refused, under advice from Zhou Yu and Lu Su that Cao Cao would surely not tolerate him even if he surrendered.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Zhou Yu set up a trap where he pretended to be punishing his subordinate _____, and Huang pretended to surrender to Cao Cao in fear
Sun Quan.fact: Zhou Yu set up a trap where he pretended to be punishing his subordinate Huang Gai, and Huang pretended to surrender to Cao Cao in fear. Zhou Yu then sent ships under Huang Gai's command to pretend to surrender and, as Huang's ships approached Cao Cao's fleet, they were set aflame to assault Cao's fleet, and Cao's fleet was largely destroyed by fire.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He then yielded parts of northern _____ to Liu Bei as well, agreeing with Liu that the south was insufficient to supply his troops
Sun Quan.fact: He then yielded parts of northern Jing Province to Liu Bei as well, agreeing with Liu that the south was insufficient to supply his troops.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: This new location gave him better control of the _____ and better communications with his various other commanders
Sun Quan.fact: This new location gave him better control of the Yangtze River and better communications with his various other commanders.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He also constructed fortresses at Ruxu, since Lü Meng anticipated an invasion there from _____
Sun Quan.fact: He also constructed fortresses at Ruxu, since Lü Meng anticipated an invasion there from Cao Cao. Sun Quan personally led the army there to resist Cao Cao and relied heavily on the fortresses Lü Meng built to give his soldiers strong positions from which to defend.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: The invasion Lü _____ expected came at the start of 213
Sun Quan.fact: He also constructed fortresses at Ruxu, since Lü Meng anticipated an invasion there from Cao Cao. The invasion Lü Meng expected came at the start of 213.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In 214, _____ sent a man named Zhu Guang to Wan County with orders to revitalise the region and bring it under Cao Cao's control

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Lü Meng feared that if _____'s programmes were successful, it would make Cao Cao's hold in the area unbreakable and urged for a campaign against Huan
Sun Quan.fact: In 214, Cao Cao sent a man named Zhu Guang to Wan County with orders to revitalise the region and bring it under Cao Cao's control. Zhu Guang began extensive agricultural projects, and he also stirred up bandits and malcontents into rebellion in Sun Quan's territory.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography

Sun Quan.question: Meantime, Lu Su and _____ advanced to Yiyang (益陽) with 10,000 men (to block Guan Yu) and took over command of the army at Lukou (陸口)
Sun Quan.fact: Rather than a lengthy siege, Lü Meng, Gan Ning and Ling Tong led a quick strike and broke Zhu Guang's defences, capturing the city. Meantime, Lu Su and Gan Ning advanced to Yiyang (益陽) with 10,000 men (to block Guan Yu) and took over command of the army at Lukou (陸口).

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Liu Bei personally went to Gong'an County and _____ led 30,000 men to Yiyang
Sun Quan.fact: Meantime, Lu Su and Gan Ning advanced to Yiyang (益陽) with 10,000 men (to block Guan Yu) and took over command of the army at Lukou (陸口). Liu Bei personally went to Gong'an County and Guan Yu led 30,000 men to Yiyang.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In 217, _____ brought a massive army to attack Ruxu again
Sun Quan.fact: When an all-out war was about to break out, the news that Cao Cao planned to attack Hanzhong was received by Liu Bei, and he requested for a border treaty with Sun Quan as he became worried about Cao Cao seizing Hanzhong. Liu Bei asked Sun Quan to give him back Lingling Commandery and create a diversion for Cao Cao by attacking Hefei; in return, Liu Bei ceded Changsha and Guiyang commanderies to Sun Quan, setting the new border along the Xiang River.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: It was a furious campaign, and after several weeks of gruelling battle, Lü Meng's defences held and the spring floods forced _____ to retreat once again
Sun Quan.fact: In 217, Cao Cao brought a massive army to attack Ruxu again. It was a furious campaign, and after several weeks of gruelling battle, Lü Meng's defences held and the spring floods forced Cao Cao to retreat once again.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Also, _____'s force was simply too large and too well-entrenched to be driven away
Sun Quan.fact: Most of Cao Cao's army was still intact and he had a huge force under Xiahou Dun north of Sun Quan's position. This resulted in a stalemate in which as long as Sun Quan kept his army in Ruxu, Xiahou Dun could not hope to invade him; but as soon as Sun Quan pulled out of Ruxu, Xiahou Dun could break through.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: While Fancheng did not fall at this time, _____ put it under siege, and the situation was severe enough that Cao Cao considered moving the capital away from Xu
Sun Quan.fact: While Fancheng did not fall at this time, Guan Yu put it under siege, and the situation was severe enough that Cao Cao considered moving the capital away from Xu. However, Sun Quan, resentful of Guan Yu's prior constant instigation of hostilities (including seizing Sun's food supplies to use for his campaign north), took the opportunity to attack Guan from the rear, and Guan's forces collapsed.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography

Sun Quan.fact: Guan Yu was captured by forces under Lü Meng and Jiang Qin; Guan Yu was executed, Jing Province came under Sun's control, and the Sun-Liu alliance ended.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography

Sun Quan.fact: Cao Pi declined, in a fateful choice that most historians believe doomed his empire to ruling only the northern and central China—and this chance would not come again.

For example, he correctly trusted the faithful Lu Xun and Zhuge Jin, so much so that he made a duplicate imperial seal and left it with Lu Xun; whenever he would correspond with Shu's emperor Liu Shan or regent Zhuge Liang, he would deliver the lette...

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In addition, the several independent kingdoms in modern _____, Laos, and southern Vietnam all became Wu vassals as well
Sun Quan.fact: In addition, the several independent kingdoms in modern Cambodia, Laos, and southern Vietnam all became Wu vassals as well.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: The Book of Liang records the arrival in 226 of a merchant from the _____ (Daqin) at Jiaozhi (Chinese-controlled northern Vietnam)

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: This tricked the Wei general _____, who led a large army south to support Zhou Fang
Sun Quan.fact: This tricked the Wei general Cao Xiu, who led a large army south to support Zhou Fang.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: He walked into the trap set by _____ and Lu Xun and suffered major losses, but was saved from total annihilation by Jia Kui
Sun Quan.fact: The one major victory that Wu would have over Wei during this period came in 228, when, with Sun Quan's approval, his general Zhou Fang pretended to be surrendering to Wei after pretending to have been punished repeatedly by Sun Quan. Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: The navy was not able to locate Danzhou but located Yizhou, and returned in 231 after capturing several thousand men—but only after 80–_____ of the navy had died from illness
Sun Quan.fact: The navy was not able to locate Danzhou but located Yizhou, and returned in 231 after capturing several thousand men—but only after 80–90% of the navy had died from illness.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: Just as _____ predicted, however, the venture would end in failure—as Zhou He and Pei Qian, on their way back, were intercepted by Wei forces and killed
Sun Quan.fact: In 232, Sun Quan had another misadventure involving his navy—as he sent his generals Zhou He (周賀) and Pei Qian (裴濳) to the nominal Wei vassal Gongsun Yuan, in control of Liaodong Commandery, to purchase horses, against the advice of Yu Fan—and indeed, he exiled Yu Fan to the desolate Cangwu Commandery (roughly modern Wuzhou, Guangxi) as punishment. Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: To his credit, he also personally went to _____'s house and apologised to him
Sun Quan.fact: Sun Quan was ecstatic, and appointed Gongsun Yuan the Prince of Yan and granted him the nine bestowments, and further sent a detachment of 10,000 men by sea north to assist Gongsun Yuan in his campaign against Wei, against the advice of nearly every single one of his high-level officials, particularly Zhang Zhao. To his credit, he also personally went to Zhang Zhao's house and apologised to him.

Sun Quan.subject: World Geography
Sun Quan.question: In 242, he appointed his son _____, born to Consort Wang, crown prince
Sun Quan.fact: In 242, he appointed his son Sun He, born to Consort Wang, crown prince. The Wiz.question: The first one was in 2000 which received great reviews and a second was run the following year in 2001 receiving exceptional reviews from the _____ press
The Wiz.fact: The first one was in 2000 which received great reviews and a second was run the following year in 2001 receiving exceptional reviews from the London press.
